[[File:Wyrm icon.png|left]]
'''Wyrmlings''' are [[Slayer monsters]] that require level 62 [[Slayer]] to kill, who are found in the Earthbound Cavern within [[Neypotzli]] after partial completion of [[Perilous Moons]], and on the island of [[Wyrmscraig]] which requires a [[Sailing]] level of 62 to access.

They can be killed as an alternative to [[wyrm]]s for a Slayer task. However, they cannot spawn the [[Superior slayer monster|superior]] [[Shadow Wyrm|shadow wyrm]]. The wyrmlings located on [[Wyrmscraig]] are in a [[multicombat area]] and a [[dwarven multicannon]] can be used.

When leaving their idle stance, they will clear any [[burn]], [[poison]], or [[venom]] effects.
